body:
Ex-Adventurer Tavern Owner

CR 3

XP 800
Male human fighter 4
CN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+5 armor, +1 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 38 (4d10+12)
Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +4; +1 bonus on Will saves against fear
Defensive Abilities armor training +1, bravery +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee Betty +7 (1d10+13/x3)
Ranged light crossbow +5 (1d8/19-20)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 19
Feats Dodge, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (bardiche), Iron Will, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (bardiche), Weapon Specialization (bardiche)
Skills Climb +7, Craft (brewing) +8, Intimidate +6, Profession (bartender) +8
Languages Common, Dwarven
NPC Gear Betty (+1 bardiche), light crossbow with 20 bolts, scale mail
